title: Grupo Bimbo Selects Turing Labs for AI Product Innovation | Turing Labs
summary: Grupo Bimbo, the world's largest baking company, selected Turing Labs as a technology partner to accelerate product development and strengthen R&D decision-making.
body_markdown:
FOR IMMEDIATE RELEASE


PALO ALTO, Calif. – November 12, 2026 – Turing Labs, the Innovation-led Growth Operating System for consumer products, today announced that Grupo Bimbo, the world's largest baking company, has selected Turing Labs as a technology partner to further strengthen its innovation capabilities.


Grupo Bimbo continues to improve its products at a scale few companies attempt. In 2026, it reported that 98% of its everyday-consumption portfolio meets its Positive Nutrition standard, defined as a Health Star Rating of 3.5 or higher.


With operations in 39 countries, more than 250 bakeries and snackeries, and a portfolio of over 10,000 products, Grupo Bimbo manages product innovation and development at extraordinary scale. Its partnership with Turing Labs brings a purpose-built artificial intelligence platform and agentic capabilities to an industry where growth no longer comes from volume alone. Consumer preferences keep shifting. Price increases can't carry growth on their own. Regulations keep evolving. And shelves only make room for launches that earn their place.


Turing Labs helps CPG companies reduce risk in product launches and develop products that deliver greater value to consumers while protecting the margins they need to grow.


> "That's why we built an Innovation-led Growth Operating System: so that every product decision, from concept to formula, makes the next one faster and better. Innovation is no longer a project; it's a capability," said Manmit Shrimali, Founder and CEO of Turing Labs.


Terms of the agreement were not disclosed.


## About Turing Labs


Turing Labs is the Innovation-led Growth Operating System, domain-trained for consumer packaged goods companies. It helps companies de-risk innovation, improve product development workflows, deliver measurable business outcomes, and bring products to market that win consumers beyond price alone. Its agentic capabilities drive productivity at scale.


Its domain-trained AI engine and orchestrated agents connect innovation strategy, formulation science, cost optimization, and institutional knowledge in one unified platform. Purpose-built for the realities of consumer product development, Turing helps R&D teams identify stronger innovation opportunities, optimize formulations across competing requirements, uncover cost savings, and accelerate the path from concept to commercialization. The platform works with existing company data and workflows, without requiring organizations to build new data infrastructure first.


Turing Labs is backed by Y Combinator and Insight Partners. Learn more at[www.turingsaas.com](https://www.turingsaas.com/)


## About Grupo Bimbo


With more than 80 years of history, Grupo Bimbo is the world's largest baking company and a leading participant in the snacks industry. Operating directly in 39 countries and serving additional markets through strategic partnerships, the company has more than 250 bakeries and snackeries and a portfolio of over 10,000 products. Its brands reach consumers across the Americas, Europe, Asia and Africa. Guided by its purpose, Nourishing a Better World, Grupo Bimbo is committed to creating value for its associates, consumers, customers, communities and the planet. Learn more at[grupobimbo.com](https://www.grupobimbo.com/) .
